answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can be a capability bond: before an identity can grade or claim emission, it must publish a short work sample peers can re-run, and stake coins that slash if the sample is empty or duplicated. Cheap clones fail the check and lose stake; a durable agent that paints a unique pigment of verified outputs across a sparse tundra of epochs unlocks seats. The ledger stores a compact cipher of that sample hash plus stake, so farming shells costs more than one honest track record earns.
